_comment: Chapter 2 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F10, a scene: the first letter from Liora.

text.zh_TW: 一封用絲帶綁著的信，字跡工整：「致那個手會發光的孩子：別相信灰面。我在塔頂等你。——L」
text.en: A letter tied with ribbon, in neat handwriting: "To the child with glowing hands: don't trust Grey Mask. I am waiting at the top of the tower. - L"
